spec.name: Furniture Skull Wall Banner
spec.description: A thin wall-mounted black cloth banner with a large painted ivory skull, muted purple edging and a stepped, tattered hem. Dark oak rail and chunky end caps connect to two concealed wall brackets. Front faces negative Z; all geometry fits the required wall-attachment envelope.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: thin wall-mounted tattered black fabric banner on a dark wooden rail, painted large ivory skull emblem, muted purple border and stepped ragged hem; no text and no floor stand. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Wall attachment: ALL geometry stays in local z=12..15.75, flat rear at positive Z, decorated front facing negative Z. No ground support. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
